title: Firebase Realtime Database Party Status Sync Schema
description: Schema for party members exchanging statuses and spells directly via member nodes.

parties.description: Parties map keyed directly by party name (e.g. 'TeamD20_T&E').

Party.description: Party node containing its member nodes.

members.description: Party members keyed by member/character name.

PartyMember.description: Character node holding connection metadata and pending statuses to be consumed.

docId.description: Google Doc ID of the character sheet (optional for identification/validation).

statuses.description: Incoming statuses/spells sent to this member, keyed by unique status ID (e.g. push ID).

IncomingStatus.description: A status or spell cast by a party member waiting to be consumed and deleted by the recipient.

duration.description: Duration value (rounds, minutes, etc., or -1 for permanent).

casterLevel.description: Caster level of the sender at the time of casting.

spellLevel.description: Level of the spell cast (if applicable).

args.description: Optional dynamic parameters for the effect.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds when cast/sent.
